_comment: PROVISIONAL PrintNC V4 Metalcutter profile (machine not built yet). From the build plan: travel about 1035 x 1035 x 150 mm, home switches back/left/top (X min, Y max, Z top), rapids limited to about 17 m/min by the 1200 mm SFU1610 screws, 4th axis up to about 150 mm swing diameter, Benchworks ATC with 6 pockets (tool number = pocket, the M6 remap measures tool length), touch probe is T99. Set tool_table to the real LinuxCNC tool.tbl once it exists. The work offset is a placeholder. Replace this file with an import of the real LinuxCNC config (IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE step 4).

body._comment: PROVISIONAL machine body in tool-tip machine coordinates (work + G54; G54 Z -120 with 18 mm stock puts the spoilboard at Z -138). Spindle parts are relative to the spindle nose (G-Penny 2.2 kW, 80 mm; ER20 nut); the gantry beam (120x80 tube) has machine X and Z and Y relative to the tool axis; the rotary unit (100 mm chuck, headstock) is relative to the jaw face on the axis and only on the table for rotary jobs. Measure and replace once the machine stands.
